name: sitememory
description: AI-powered spatial memory for physical environments.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sitememory/api" "npm run dev -w @sitememory/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sitememory/shared && npm run build -w @sitememory/api && npm run build -w @sitememory/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sitememory/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.evaluate: npm run build -w @sitememory/shared && npm run build -w @sitememory/api && node scripts/evaluate.mjs
